name: app-store-compliance
description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 124 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 112 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A checklist and automated guard that catches the mistakes that get mobile apps rejected from the App Store or Google Play, and flags upcoming privacy-law deadlines, before you submit.
buyer: A solo indie app developer or small mobile studio that has been burned by app store rejections and can't afford a dedicated compliance or legal person.
business_use_cases: A solo indie developer runs it before every submission to catch privacy-manifest and metadata issues that would otherwise cause a multi-day rejection cycle.
A small mobile agency offers 'guaranteed first-try approval' as a selling point to clients by running this checklist as part of QA.
A compliance consultant uses the tracked-deadline list (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA) to proactively alert mobile-app clients about upcoming legal requirements, as a retainer service.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid pre-submission compliance audit service for indie developers and small studios.
Build a hosted dashboard that tracks a studio's apps against the 112 deadlines and alerts them, sold as a subscription.

steal_this: Turn this into a paid pre-submission checklist service on Upwork or Fiverr for indie app developers this weekend — review their app against the 124 patterns for a flat fee.
